name: chelan-county-campus-map-3d
description: Interactive 3D Chelan County Government Campus Map with Three.js & Procedural Wall/Tree Asset Foundry

scripts.start: node -e "import('http').then(http=>import('fs').then(fs=>import('path').then(path=>{const m={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.png':'image/png','.json':'application/json'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let u=req.url.split('?')[0];if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const f=path.join(process.cwd(),u);fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');}else{res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(d);}})}).listen(3080,()=>console.log('Chelan County 3D Campus Map running at http://localhost:3080'))})))"
